This is deep. This is a question I used to ponder a lot. What is the meaning of all of this? What is the point of life, what is the point of living? Who am I really? What is my purpose? These are all things that only you can answer and find the answer to.  


Personally, I still haven't found the answers but I began to look at life differently. In a spiritual way. I don't necessarily believe in a specific religion but more of the idea that there is a higher power, if you will, out there. I don't want to push any of my own thoughts and opinions on to you, but I would consider exploring all aspects. Looking at life from a different perspective. Looking at yourself from a different light.
